note: Preview only: original two gripper sides oscillate about their own pivots. Three turntable views show left/center/right base yaw. No extra arms, cat paws or nose-covering. View labels are visual design targets, not calibrated motor angles.
jaw_structure: two whole rigid sides; each yellow shell and black pad share one transform; no sub-fingers

size_reference.note: Daily idle is the size reference, not another dance clip. A single fixed setup scale calibrates each whole jaw; the far jaw sits behind the near jaw with 60 source-pixel hinge separation. The isolated unrotated 32px bound is a calibration guard, not a pixel-identical silhouette claim. Rotation, perspective and occlusion change visible bounds; never fit size per frame.

layout_note: Viewer-left near jaw drawn last; viewer-right jaw slightly behind and higher. Fixed mounting separation calibrated against daily idle; both remain complete rigid units, no animated scaling.
mount_policy: No exposed common wrist collar. Complete jaws attach directly under the green face edge; a foreground chin layer hides their root tabs. View-specific fixed mounts, unchanged jaw size, separation and beat motion.
